text:
alex: heads-up: deploy-bot flagged a vuln-scan issue and SBOM provenance missing for a transitive lib in canary-eu. thinking regional carveout + pin. opinions?

priya: paste the deploy-bot details plz

alex: paste below:
```
deploy-bot: security-scan: vuln-range low
sbom-scan: provenance-missing
component: smallnet@0.9.7 (transitive)
affected: canary-eu
```

omar: severity low but provenance-missing triggers legal review per policy. legal-qa-bot any quick guidance?

legal-qa-bot: recommend pin-to-digest for that region, add note to release notes. If provenance can't be attached within 24h escalate to sec for rollback.

priya: ops plan: 1) pin canary-eu to previous image 2) mark rollout-state=limited 3) continue other regions. low blast radius.

alex: can someone run the redeploy command?

deploy-bot: redeploy --cluster=canary-eu --image=registry/redwood/service:20260318@sha256:1111aaaa --reason="sbom-provenance-carveout"

priya: running redeploy now.

deploy-bot: job started id=2026-555, progress 0%

priya: redeploy done. canary-eu pinned. health checks green. routes set to limited.

omar: i'll bisect the lockfile to find which dependency pulled smallnet.

alex: i'll update release notes: "EU canary limited due to SBOM provenance follow-up for transitive smallnet. No customer impact."

oncall: noted, monitoring metrics for canary-eu. will alert if any regressions.

omar: bisect complete  smallnet introduced by embedder@2.0.4 in PR #901. opening PR to pin embedder to 2.0.3 and attach SBOM metadata.

alex: once PR merges, request sbom re-scan in canary-eu and then lift carveout. documenting next steps in INF-2027.

priya: thanks all, closing loop for now :white_check_mark:
